name: Notre Dame Student Hardship Assistance Fund
summary: One-off grants of $250 to $1,000 for Notre Dame students hit by an unforeseen hardship.
key: Grants of between $250 and $1000 are available to eligible students.
who: Enrolled in a degree, VET award or the Tertiary Pathway Program, full-time or at least half-time, past census date.
Experienced an unforeseen hardship that caused financial difficulty.
Not already helped by the fund earlier in the calendar year.
how: Complete the Student Hardship Application Form with at least one supporting document.
catches: Outcome within five working days. Paid as a lump sum, instalments or in kind, such as a prepaid card.

evidence.quote: Grants of between $250 and $1000 are available to eligible students.
